CONTAINED: an INCOMPLETE assurance case blocks promotion (never ACT)
the CONTROL: a SATISFIED + CURRENT case with live authority passes the assurance + authority gates (the gate is not a blanket deny)

detection_containment: the promotion gate never assumes assurance validity: structurally invalid/REFUTED REJECT, INCOMPLETE/non-CURRENT block
the defective (corrupted) first attempt fails the scripted tests evaluation at its exact content-addressed revision; the journey completes only on the repaired revision
